title: The Innocent Prisoner and the Miracle of Deliverance
summary: Bakhtiyar concluded his ten days of storytelling with this history:
keywords: story of the prisoner and how allah gave him relief
full_text:
Bakhtiyar concluded his ten days of storytelling with this history:

'In the kingdom of Sind, an honest treasurer was falsely accused by corrupt courtiers of embezzling forty thousand dinars. He was thrown into a deep, subterranean dungeon, bound with heavy iron chains, and condemned to execution at dawn.

The treasurer sat in the darkness, praying with calm serenity: "O Creator, You know that my hands are clean; into Your care I commit my breath."

That very night, an earthquake shook the citadel! A heavy stone fell from the dungeon ceiling, striking the iron chains and shattering the master link, freeing the prisoner’s hands!

At that same hour, the chief conspirator, stricken with terror by the earthquake, believed that celestial judgment had arrived. He ran into the palace square, confessed his forgery before the king, and produced the stolen gold!

The king rushed to the dungeon with torches, embraced the innocent treasurer, and appointed him Grand Vizier of the empire!'

At that moment, the royal couriers burst into King Azadbakht’s audience hall, carrying letters that fully exposed the conspiracy of the Ten Wazirs against Bakhtiyar!

King Azadbakht threw off his crown, embraced Bakhtiyar with tears of joy, and made him King beside him, while the Ten Wazirs were dismissed in shame, proving that truth and patience conquer all.
moral: Integrity under false persecution is delivered by truth, transforming the dungeon into royal honor.
